First ReClash pre-release.

<!-- reclash:changelog:begin -->
### Features
- Smart Routing: automatic node selection with explanations.
- Redesigned home screen, desktop navigation and regional setup wizard.
- Cosmetic findings and Linux Helper support.
- Local subscription conversion, Amnezia import and provider panels.
- Smart Pause on trusted networks and `reclash://` automation.
- Material You, scheduled themes, AMOLED styling and custom icons.
- Uzbek, Kazakh, Turkmen and Korean translations.
- Experimental ByeDPI on Android: DPI-only mode and strategy testing.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed TUN startup and authorization on read-only installs.
- Fixed profile migration crashes and incorrect Smart Pause states.
- Capped Smart Routing handoffs at 10 seconds; fixed profile theme switching.

<!-- reclash:changelog:end -->

<!-- reclash:release-epoch:1 -->

## Known issues

- Windows: this build's installer carries FlClash's application id, so on a machine that already has FlClash it installs into FlClash's folder and shares its "Apps & features" entry instead of its own `ReClash` directory. Uninstall FlClash first or use the portable ZIP; the next pre-release ships a unique installer id.
